title: Auto-probe local CLI agents on registration and when the bridge comes online
spec: Local CLI coding agents (Codex/Claude style) have no health endpoint, so a freshly registered or restarted agent sits at health status "unknown" until someone manually triggers a probe. Change the server's agent routes so that (1) when a CLI agent whose command looks like a known coding CLI is manually registered, a restricted health probe is scheduled automatically, and (2) when the desktop bridge comes online, CLI agents still at unknown health get probed once — without re-probing endlessly on every reconnect.
